europe_now.title: Starlink Restrictions Impair Ukrainian Military Operations
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian military personnel report that recent restrictions on Starlink are severely impacting front-line operations and drone missions. Officials in Kyiv are urging the United States, SpaceX, and NATO to clarify the limitations.
